name: Barn Conversion, Pangbourne
lede: On two acres an hour from London, a former tennis court became an outdoor entertaining space inside a barn conversion. Black Platinum Electric heaters, with zoned dimming, replace open-element heaters the owner never liked.
data: Private home – outdoor room in a barn conversion
Platinum Smart-Heat® Electric 3400 W, black (12 recommended)

beats: The 1920s house sits on two acres outside Pangbourne. Where a tennis court once was, the owner built an entertaining space in a barn conversion that fully shelters it from the weather.

He wanted the space in use year-round, with heat whenever it cooled, in place of open-element heaters that looked ugly, rusted and gathered cobwebs – and he needed guidance on which heaters, and how many.
Bromic’s design service recommended twelve black Platinum Electric 3400 W heaters, with a Wireless Dimmer Controller and a Master Remote for dimming and zoned control.

quote.text: Our guests have been wowed by the entertainment space and impressed with the heaters.
